question: Related Questions Q. Marriage hindrance 1907 views Q. Dream 1382 views Q. Assalam Aly kum May the Blessings of Allah be upon you and my brothers and sisters. Thanks for answering my previous question. In my dream i was with my elder brother, we were standing on the terrace of our old house in night it was almost 3.30 in night. we were discussing about deen. i told my brother see the moon Hozoor sallalahu aliahi wa sallam just showed his finger and the moon split in 2 pieces see how Allah can do and while i was telling this i showed my finger to the moon and it split into 2 pieces. Again we were talking then i saw the moon it was a full moon.then again i started to say about moon spliting into 2 i was really excited about this so i was telling him again see how much power allah has Hozoor sallalahu aliahi wa sallam just showed his finger and the moon split in 2 pieces see how Allah can do and while i was telling this i showed my finger to the moon and it split into 2 pieces again i told my brother lets see were this part of moon to my right side goes i saw it for a while than i was not able to see it becasue it had gone far and was looking very tiny then i was speaking with my brother from the right side a storm(twister) came wind was circling very fast and i realised it was coming towards us i told my brother it i coming here we did not run we stood there the wind came to us and me and my brother were in it i caught the pillar so that i dont get blown away and my brother was behind me then the wind took me and i heard some voice i could not here it i felt like some one is operating my heart i could feel pain in my chest the voice asked me something but i dont remember it and then i saw the moon it was full i was still trapped in the storm again a voice asked me are you ready i told yes and the storm stoped and turned into water vapours and all water fell on me and i was breathing heavily i was not able to brethe at all so i went to my house it was morning now and i entered my room and my sleep broke i got up and saw the time it was 3.40 in night still. after i got up i could feel some pain in my chest and heavy brething, i was not able to brethe when i got up i was pulling the air. please tell me about this dream and let me know what i should do i really get strange dreams. 1512 views Q. A few years back I had the privilege of attending a few lectures of Hazrat Moulana Anzar Shah Saheb (DB) in my local masjid. Since then, I have had a few dreams about him and would like to know their meanings. 1. I had a dream that Moulana Saheb (DB) was very weak and was about to break into pieces inside my local masjid and I was carrying him and trying to get help for him. Others were also trying to help, e.g. my brothers and friends but I did not let them and I said to then that they don't know how to help him and that only I could do this. 2. I had a dream that I wa following Hazrat Moulana (DB) around the UK as he was delivering various talks around the country and that I was also studying under him at the same time whilst he travelled around. 3. I had another dream about a famous Scholar in the UK. I dreamt that He was teaching (dars) in the dar ul uloom where he teaches. I dreamt that I was sitting infront of him and that he requested me to read and explain the book he was doing a dars of and I refused saying "How can I read anything in your presence" but he insisted and so I began reading the book. However, as soon as I started reading, the respected Scholar got up hastily and left the room and everyone followed him out. 1457 views Q. Dream 1613 views Q. Dream about light 1262 views Q.
